High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 6074 of 2020
Applicant :- Ramakant Ram
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and gone through the entire file.
2.

By way of this application under Section 438 CrPC, the accused-applicant seeks bail,
apprehending his arrested pursuant to FIR/Case Crime No.032B of 2006 lodged at Police Station Dubhar, District Ballia.

3. On behalf of the accused-applicant, it is submitted that this Court while considering Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 CrPC No.6094 of 2020 filed by the similarly situated co-accused, Devendra Singh has disposed of the same vide order dated 17.11.2020, which reads as under:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant - Devendra Singh, seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.32B of 2006, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 477-A, 120-B/34 I.P.C. and Section 13 (2)
Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station - Dubhar, District - Ballia, during the pendency of trial.
3. By order dated 23.09.2020, coercive measures have been stayed.

That order has remained in operation till date, which is quoted below:
"Heard Sri Santosh Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned AGA and perused the material available on record.
Exemption application is allowed.
Learned counsel for the applicant is directed to remove the defect, if any, pointed out by the office within a month.

Present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant - Devendra Singh in Case Crime No.32B of 2006,
under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 477-A, 120-B/34 I.P.C. and 13 (2) Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station - Dubhar, District ? Ballia.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is village development officer.
No specific role has been assigned to him in the F.I.R. Matter relates to the year 2001 to 2006.
Applicant has not embezzled or misappropriated any amount.
Allegation of irregularities said to have been made in distribution of food grains is also false.
Dinesh Kumar Pathak, who was posted as block development officer, has been granted anticipatory bail in this matter through criminal misc.
anticipatory bail application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 557 of 2020.
It is further submitted that many other co-accused have been granted relief from arrest till submission of the charge-sheet in this matter.
Accusation levelled against the applicant are of similar nature.
If the applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty and will cooperate with the investigation.
Applicant has apprehension of his arrest by the police any time.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer and prayed for some time to file counter affidavit in the matter.
In the circumstances, as requested, learned A.G.A. is allowed four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.

As an interim protection, till the next date fixed for final hearing on this application,
applicant is granted anticipatory bail in the aforesaid crime number.

In the event of arrest of the applicant, he shall be released on anticipatory bail on his furnishing a Ramakant Ram vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198054550/
2 personal bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police office as and when required.

entities.text: Ramakant Ram vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ( ii )

The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the Country without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by them before the S.S.P./S.P. Concerned.
(iv) The party shall file self-attested computer generated copy of this order downloaded from the official website of High Court Allahabad.

The concerned Court/Authority/Official shall verify the authenticity of such computerized copy of the order from the official website of High Court Allahabad and shall make a declaration of such verification in writing.
In case of default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of interim protection granted to the applicant.

List this case on 17.11.2020 before the appropriate Court."
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that upon time granted by earlier order,
nothing adverse has come on record.
5. In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the present application pending or calling for counter affidavit at this stage.
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case, at this stage.

6. In the event of arrest of the applicant - Devendra Singh involved in the aforesaid case crime, he shall be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of the trial, on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned on the following conditions:
(i) The applicant shall make him available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.

(ii) The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the Ramakant Ram vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198054550/
3 evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the court.

entities.text: Ramakant Ram vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iv) In default of any of the conditions mentioned above, the investigating officers shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, the present application is disposed of."

4. Having considered the submission, the present anticipatory bail application is also disposed of in the same terms as Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 CrPC No.6094 of 2020 was disposed of.
